notes.title: Update 1.0.63.3672
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/2dcac27ff136595c7d0c7a66439d633582677a90.jpg"]

Interface:

Added display of hotkey on the "Take All" button.

Added display of hotkey on the Translocator icon.

Fixed display of the rotation angle characteristic icon for outboard motors.

Added display of the game camera’s view direction on the fullscreen map.

In voice chat, default setting changed to "Hear only group members".

Game & Quests:

After boarding a new boat, its hull is now automatically added to the list of blueprints at the base.

Fixed marker in the Atmans bomb quest.

Fixed quest names in the starting questline for obtaining a boat from the Shipbuilder.

Added a quest to the starting questline to simplify initial access to the base. Access to the base is now possible before hiring a manager.

Balance:

Fixed a bug where the Steering Cabins bonus to battery durability also incorrectly affected hull side durability.

Alter Ego skill "Equipment Master" now adds 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 units of generated energy per hull rank instead of 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 earlier.

Kichiro and Paul’s skill "Equipment Master" now adds 3 units of generated energy per hull rank instead of 1 earlier.

Increased speed gain from Rank 1 outboard motor from 5 to 7.

Increased speed gain from Rank 2 outboard motor from 10 to 14.

Increased base energy generation of all hulls. Rank 1 hulls now average up to 30, Rank 5 hulls up to 90 ("ST Okta" with its 600 remains unchanged).

Decorative Horse module now occupies less space and has a smaller installation slot.

notes.title: Update 1.0.59.3667
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/1d884a1cfdb1c8c263a1fcdfb0970d2469130f37.jpg"]

Errors related to the addition of the new "Armor" category have been fixed. Bonuses to rocket characteristics have been added for the Old Tank Base. Minor balance adjustments have been made.

Bug Fixes:

A bug that prevented viewing items from the "Armor" category in the base production menu and, consequently, their production has been fixed.

A bug that caused the display of characteristics for items from the "Armor" category to be turned off has been fixed.

An icon for items from the "Armor" category has been added to the item card and repair menu.

The category for some turret bases has been corrected; they are now correctly filtered by the "Structures" category and repaired according to the set repair priority for this category.
Changes in Turret Base Characteristics
Old Tank Base

Level has been increased from 3 to 5.

Energy consumption has been increased from 1 to 24.

Mass has been increased from 1700 to 2400.

Durability has been increased from 2400 to 18000.

Bonuses to weapons installed on the base have been reworked.

The base enhances cannons: +40% damage, vertical aiming angles +250%, turn speed +70%.

The base enhances rocket launchers: +30% damage, rocket flight speed +30%, rocket maneuverability +25%.

Helicopter Scrap Base

Level has been increased from 3 to 5.

Durability has been increased from 3000 to 9000.

Abrams turret base:

Bonus to explosive damage for grenade launchers has been reduced from 150% to 100%

Bonus to explosion radius for grenade launchers has been reduced from 5 to 4 meters.
Changes in Weapons
“Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher”

Base explosive damage has been increased from 3960 to 4800.

Explosion radius has been increased from 13 to 14 meters.

Comment: The enhancement of the launcher is aimed at compensating for the weakening of bonuses to grenade launchers from the Abrams turret base, as the smoke launcher cannot be considered a standalone weapon type capable of inflicting significant damage without this base.
Cannons
Reload time has been reduced:

Cannon VI PP 100 mm by 15%.

Cannon V PP 90 mm by 25%.

Cannon IV PP 75 mm by 30%.

Cannon III PP 60 mm by 35%.

Cannon II PP 50 mm by 40%.

Cannon I PP 45 mm by 45%.

Comment: Statistics show low effectiveness of this weapon type, especially at low levels when crew reload perks are not yet leveled up. We hope that this enhancement, combined with the ability to get a 40% damage boost from the Old Tank Base, will help achieve the required effectiveness.

Grenade Launchers:

Bonus to explosive damage from structures has been reduced from 20% to 10%.

Comment: Statistics show an extremely high effectiveness of grenade launchers specifically in combination with installed turret bases, so we decided not to directly reduce the characteristics of grenade launchers, but only to weaken the damage bonus from structures.

Flamethrowers:

Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 110.

Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 150 to 160.

Minigun:

Base durability has been increased from 180,000 to 270,000.

Base turn speed has been increased from 10 to 15 deg/sec.

The characteristics of weapons now display the "Projectile velocity" parameter, and rocket characteristics display "Missile maneuverability".

notes.title: Update 1.0.58.3665
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/b55c1a39328f3078b2dfe2987a2a9848d16f9c46.png"]

Atman confrontation quest fixes and minor balance adjustments.
Fixes in the Atman confrontation quest chain:
Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when moving certain quest items from the Atmans confrontation chain to the base warehouse.

A bug where quest items for the Atman confrontation quest chain dropped even without the corresponding quests has been fixed.

Quest items from the Atman confrontation quest chain can now be thrown overboard, which will allow getting rid of items that were obtained due to an error.

A bug where it was impossible to get the "Spare Parts" quest from NPC Ashley on the aircraft carrier  to obtain Atman Weapon Fragments has been fixed. This repeatable quest is now correctly issued.

A quest objective marker has been added in the aircraft carrier quest to destroy the Atman flagship.

The reward for repeatable Atman quests has been increased from 5000 to 15000 medallions.

The chance of medallions dropping from Atman ships no longer depends on the presence of active quests for obtaining their items for repeatable quests.

Text and localization fixes.
Increased power gain from funnels, air intakes, and fan motors:
Power gain from "Huge Funnel" Level 5 has been increased from 300,000 to 420,000.

Power gain from "Midsize Funnel" Level 4 has been increased from 120,000 to 170,000.

Power gain from "Warship Air Intake" Level 5 has been increased from 72,000 to 104,000.

Power gain from "Steamship Air Intake" Level 4 has been increased from 26,000 to 36,000.

Base power of Fan Motors of Rank 3-5 has been increased by 33%.
Changes in weapon characteristics:
Machine Gun Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 10 to 16.

Grenade Launcher Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 30 to 60.

Grenade Launchers:

Bonus to explosion radius from structures has been reduced from 2 to 1 meter (except for Three-Story Cabin and Abrams turret base).

Shotguns:

Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 120 meters.

Bullet damage falloff with distance has been reduced by 20% (effective range increased).

Flamethrowers:

Maximum range has been increased from 80 to 100 meters.

Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 120 to 150.

Comment: Minor adjustments to grenade launchers and machine guns were planned to be implemented  in the update 1.0.52.3655, but were postponed to collect more statistics and analyze them. These two weapon types show higher than expected effectiveness, but due to their high popularity among players, we decided not to directly reduce their damage, but to limit it over a long firing interval by increasing energy consumption per shot. At the same time, shotguns and flamethrowers, despite their high damage, are unable to realize it due to the need for close combat with the enemy. We hope that increasing the effective attack range will allow these weapon types to find more fans.

"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"

Energy consumption reduced from 210 to 140.

Comment: Although this installation is not a full-fledged weapon type, we hope that such a reduction in energy consumption will allow it to be combined with shotguns and flamethrowers for safe approach to enemies in PvP events.

Dreadripper

Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.

Minigun durability has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.

Minigun damage has been increased by 50%.

To sink Dreadripper, it is now necessary to blow up 5 fuel tanks instead of 4.

Erroneous display of the boss marker in separate locations intended for battles with other bosses has been disabled.

Display of the boss marker for players on ships below Rank 4 has been disabled.
Hull Material Changes
Plastic Sheathing:

Speed bonus has been increased from 20% to 25%.

Ship mass reduction bonus has been improved from -30% to -40%.

Wood Sheathing:

Resistance to burning damage disabled.

Metal Sheathing:

Hull mass penalty has been reduced from 15% to 10%.

Segment durability bonus has been increased from 150% to 180%.
Other changes and fixes:
Side armor and other protective structures have been moved to a separate inventory category, and their repair priority can now be configured separately.

The intensity of passive water ingress through a breached segment has been increased for Rank 4 and 5 hulls, by 1.5 and 2 times respectively.

Comment: This change specifically affects passive (slow) flooding of the hull when side segments are destroyed. The goal is to reduce situations where high rank ships, equipped with a large number of pumps, could remain nearly invincible even when more than half of their segments were destroyed.

Text chat pop-up messages are now separated from notifications about receiving and sorting items and other notifications. An option to disable chat messages has been added to the settings.

High-level dredges now consume significantly more energy to start the mining process.

For most rank 1 and 2 ships, base energy production has been increased by 10 units.

Visual effects of hits and module damage have been  improved, and missing ones have been added.

Acidic algae, which caused damage over time to the main ship in the PvP event "Attack on Caravan", have been removed from its path.

notes.title: Update 1.0.52.3655
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/5afa5b6b2bdd3d8f60c8186c42467762b5c9d521.jpg"]A new quest line, new weapons - 3 flamethrowers of different rarity, reduced fleet respawn time and text chat bug fixes await you in our new update.

Added a new quest line where you have to fight the Atman fleets and disrupt their plans. Start it by talking to the mayor in Three Whales! Note: Dialogue texts in new quests may contain errors and inaccuracies, and voice acting is absent, we plan to fix this in the future.

Added three flamethrowers of different rarity

From the loot of Atman's Rank 5 ships ("Grasp", "ST Octa", "Glare" and "Midori"), which appear in some fleets on the last wave:

"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1% chance.

"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 0.5% chance.

"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.1% chance.

From Dreadripper's loot:

"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1.5% chance.

"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 1% chance.

"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.3% chance.

Pirate Flotillas

Respawn time interval has been reduced from 60-360 seconds to 60-75 seconds.

Atman Flotillas

Respawn time interval has been reduced from 150-450 seconds to 75-90 seconds.

Experience gained for sinking ships from the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased from 750 to 1500.

The amount of medallions obtained from opponents of the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased by 2 times.

Text chat bug fixes

Fixed several general text chat channel errors that caused message delivery and reception failures after grouping up.

Fixed an error that caused text chat to disconnect when voice chat was disconnected.

Text message delivery is no longer limited by distance between players.

Fixed a bug that caused the nickname of the sender of a private message to be displayed as "Unknown".

Dreadripper

Minimum spawn distance to the nearest player has been increased from 500 to 1500 meters.

Boss marker display distance has been increased from 3000 to 8000 meters.

Boss respawn time has been reduced from 40 to 30 minutes.

Fixed power consumption issue that caused four artillery guns located inside the hull to shut down.

Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 650,000 to 1,000,000.

Miniguns have been moved from the bow platform to the side cranes.

A second four-barreled gun has been added to the bow platform.

Dead zones have been added to each weapon, for example, the rocket launcher will no longer attack at distances less than 250 meters, and all weapons have limited aiming angles.

Comment: Dreadripper has become stronger in situations where you are far from it, and it is able to fire from all weapons, but at the same time, situations where it can fire through its own hull are almost completely excluded. Thus, by getting closer to it, you can find safe places, which will become more numerous as Dreadripper's weapons are destroyed.

Boss behind the "Hunt for the 'Scuttlefish' (Group)" teleport

All weapon damage has been reduced by 25%.

Detonation of each of the three generators now reduces the boss's total durability by 9% instead of 5%.

Experience gained for destruction has been reduced from 9000 to 7000.

Time interval blocking loot drop in case of too fast repeated boss destruction has been reduced from 60 to 40 seconds.

PvP mission "Attack on Caravan"

Durability of the main ship and escort ships has been increased by 8 and 20 times respectively.

Reward for sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.

Reward for assisting in sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.

Reward gained per 1 second of caravan escort for defenders has been increased from 50 to 100 medallions.

Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.

PvP mission "Treasure Hunt"

The condition for starting missions in the northeast and southeast has been simplified. Now they should start more often.

Capture point time in all locations has been increased to 180 seconds.

Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.

Machine Guns

Overheating mechanic has been disabled.

For machine guns of levels 1-4, magazine size has been reduced to 125.

Machine gun spread now decreases with weapon level, improving accuracy. Machine guns of levels 1–4 had their spread increase per shot raised by 20–40%, while levels 5 and 6 had it lowered by 15% and 50% respectively.

Shotguns

Shotgun damage has been increased by 40%.

"Dreadripper Minigun"

Base mass has been reduced from 150,000 to 120,000.

Maximum and minimum spread has been reduced by 20%.

Maximum projectile flight distance has been increased from 600 to 700 meters.

"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"

Energy consumption per shot has been reduced from 5000 to 3000.

Explosion radius has been increased from 11 to 13 meters.

Other improvements and fixes:

Turning radius of the ST Octa Seiner has been improved.

Comment: Please note that due to the relatively low mass of the ship itself, its small width, and high speed, with a large number of heavy modules on deck, the ship may experience stability problems during sharp turns. It was impossible to improve the turning radius without these problems due to the peculiarities of the game physics engine, which strives to realistically model the behavior of ships of different hull shapes and displacements.

Durability of outboard motors of levels 2-5 has been increased by 2-2.5 times.

Cost of Smith's Neutralizer consumable, which allows resetting skills, has been reduced from 250,000 to 150,000 medallions.

To improve comfort at the start of the game, the structure of the initial quest chain has been improved, some starting locations have been moved closer to the Three Whales, and water flows have been added.

Fibers and ropes have been removed from drag repair recipes, and instrument parts from the "Looter Drone" recipe.

Base quest names are now highlighted in a different color.

Chance to get loot for assist has been increased from 25% to 33%.

In the Chasm location, gates now open from both sides.

Stack size of temporary boosters has been increased from 500 to 10,000 (already existing boosters will be combined after leaving the base).

Amount of mining loot in large zones has been reduced from 14 to 7, their respawn time has also been reduced by 2 times.

Radioisotope generator disassembly recipe has been corrected.

Improvements have been made to the anchor and compass interface, also hints about keys that call certain menus have been added.

Bonus from structures to shotgun firing range now correctly updates when moving the shotgun.

Buoys marking the boundary of the game world are now arranged in a circle, and exiting this boundary leads to teleportation to the Three Whales (in some cases this can be used instead of a translocator)

The location of the "Trader 12" island has been slightly changed so that after teleportation you can freely sail north.

Thank you for your feedback and reports. We’ve released a small update 1.0.55.3660 where we’ve fixed a few errors:
[p align="justify"]The rewards from the 'Abrams turret base' have been fixed. Players who had completed the relevant quests have now received their rewards. The old rewards have been rendered unusable and can now be salvaged for resources.
[p align="justify"]Flamethrower rewards in quests have been fixed (we’re still working on a solution for the players who have completed the corresponding quests but didn't receive flamethrowers).
[p align="justify"]Several bugs in repeatable quests of the new quest chain have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.51.3640
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/62d41b335cc20033be05fffa3656b43b403943cd.jpg"]

In this update, the hulls of the Glare Rocket Boat and the Torpedo Boat Midori have been slightly nerfed, while the Grasp Tugboat and the ST Octa Seiner have been buffed to increase the demand for them and open up new tactical possibilities.

Machine guns—as one of the most popular and versatile weapon types—have been tweaked to make them more balanced, especially in PvP. The minigun can still fire all 480 rounds without overheating, but if you increase its magazine size with structural bonuses it may now overheat. You can avoid overheating by assigning the minigun to a crew member with the “Knowledge of Physics” skill.

We’ve also paid attention to grenade launchers: thanks to the increased projectile velocity, firing them is now more convenient, which we hope will attract new fans to this weapon class.

Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Wind Energy and New Horizons: Q&A about the Storm Tuning Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/80556e764ce5ff059b49047d8ee9e73f9587323a.jpg"]

Dear friends! We’ve released an update for Age of Water: new ships and weapons have been added, the new energy system is ready to challenge your construction skills, and PvP rewards have been significantly increased.

In this post, we’ll answer the most frequent questions about the balance changes, energy, and weapons. Thank you for your support and feedback: it helps us make the game better!
Q: What are the main goals and objectives of this update?
A: Our primary aim is to breathe new life into Age of Water and make balancing between speed, firepower, and survivability more challenging and fun. We’ve increased the variety of ships and weapons, rebalanced energy consumption and rewards, and ensured that every choice in the shipbuilder carries weight and encourages fresh tactics.
Q: How do I rebuild my top-tier ship in light of the new changes?
A: Now there isn’t enough energy to power everything you want, so plan carefully! We recommend first removing any extra Fan Motor modules and adding structures that boost energy production. For example, the "Torpedo Boat Midori Cabin" and the "Rook Boat Cabin A" now provide huge energy bonuses, but, as with many other cabins, they’ve been moved into a new "wheelhouse" category, of which you may set up only one per ship. However, there are other cabins and modules that grant energy boosts without that restriction (see the in-game descriptions), such as the "Three-Story Cabin”," "Rook Boat Cabin B," "Rook Boat Cabin C," and the "Halibut Conning Tower." Think through module placement and their energy demands, and balance your ship’s armament, speed, hull durability, and free cargo space to fit the new meta.
Q: How can I achieve sufficient energy after the update if I lack resources to craft generators and modules that give them bonuses?
A: The quickest and most cost-effective route is to craft wind generators at your base. They’ll cover basic needs and simple builds.
Q: Does it still make sense to craft an expensive Rank 5 radioisotope generator if a cheaper Rank-5 wind generator produces more energy?
A: Wind generators can look more efficient at first glance, but note that they only receive durability bonuses from modules—not energy production bonuses—and each installed wind generator increases the overall energy output penalty for all wind generators.
Q: Why did you make such radical changes to familiar gameplay elements?
A: We overhauled the core balance for the long-term health of the game, aiming to add depth and variety to ship and weapon choices. Before the patch, the dominant build was obvious—Midori, cisterns, cannons—leaving little room for alternatives. Now there are many viable builds, making it much harder to declare any single setup "the best."
Q: Won’t these updates devalue old content and the time players invested? And why were cannons changed so drastically?
A: We don’t believe old items are devalued. On top-tier builds, standard generators remain the best choice. While weapon balance has shifted—many older weapons have actually become more effective—cannons and rockets, if anything, lost efficiency through higher energy costs rather than reduced damage. Cannons were too universally strong—about 75% of players used only them—so we increased their energy consumption to open the field to other weapon types. Their raw damage remains the same, but in the new energy scarcity meta they no longer feel as dominant. Energy efficiency and build strategy now matter as much as sheer damage output.

We understand this may be uncomfortable for the players who were used to their ship builds. But we hope that new opportunities and challenges will introduce you to different weapon setups while we continue keeping an eye out on the weapon balance.
Q: How has the maximum speed of ships changed after the rebalance?
A: Gone are the days of 200-knot flying boats (with rare exceptions). With a well-planned build—say, ten Level 6 cannons—you can still reach a comfortable 80–130 knots, depending on your hull choice.
Q: Why disable multiple respawn points and limit respawning to the Three Whales?
A: By leaving only one respawn point at the Three Whales, we’ve raised the stakes for each life. Returning to your death spot now requires using a translocator—and possibly a powerbank to recharge it. We also disabled forced cargo drops on death so you can decide whether to return to the place of your demise or move on.
Q: What do you hope to achieve with these changes?
A: We aim for a balance in which every player can build a ship tailored to their play style or a specific activity, weighing survivability, firepower, and speed. We also updated repair costs—previous resource requirements didn’t match gameplay realities, so most players repaired only hulls. Now that ship preservation is vital, lower repair costs will help.
Q: What data will you focus on after the update? Which feedback is most important?
A: We’re closely monitoring event statistics, ship and weapon selections, and player feedback on energy and weapon balance. We want to know what challenges you face when rebuilding your ship, whether your generators are sufficient, and your thoughts on the new meta and weapon balance. Your insights will guide our future balance decisions.
Q: Will you continue to make balance tweaks going forward?
A: We’ve already released one balance patch and will continue to track the situation and apply further adjustments as needed.

notes.title: Update Storm Tuning (1.0.48.3630)
notes.notes:
New ships and weapons, easier repairs, improved hull-part stats, and increased PvP rewards. Energy consumption has also risen, so we’ve added new wind turbines. Weapons are now significantly more powerful, and on-foot mode is available in every major location.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/e5071c6245be363726db1cb81997849c3face65b.jpg"]
New Ships and Weapons


Added new vessels available for boarding:

• Rank V: ST Octa Seiner

Its deck is smaller and hull is weaker than its peers, but it generates 300 energy. In afterburner mode it boosts top speed by 35% instead of the standard 20%.

• Rank IV: Bulldog Trawler, Whiteout Boat, Brynhild Motor Sailer

• Rank III: Charisma Sailboat, Stripe Patrol Boat, Riviera Motorboat

• Rank II: Glam Sailboat, Caspian Small Trawler, Ares Multipurpose Boat, Bass Torpedo Boat, Exodus Survey Vessel, Fishing Trawler

• Rank I: Husky Launch, Nyneve Boat, Minnie Minesweeper, Pomor Tugboat, Tragula Trawler, Leiden Boat

New Level VII weapons:

• Minigun

1% drop chance in the loot of the Dreadreaper found beyond the sector boundary. Additionally, the Dreadreaper now guarantees 1 000–20 000 Chemical Waste per drop.

• Smoke Grenade Launcher

1% drop chance in the loot of the enhanced Dead Scuttlefish Boat found behind the “Hunt for the ‘Scuttlefish’ (Group)” teleport.


Economic & Resource Changes


• Repair costs reduced dramatically

Resource requirements for repairing gear and weapons have been cut by tens to hundreds of times. Most items now repair using Scrap Iron only.

• Consumable cooldowns added

All consumables now have a cooldown: 45 s (Nitro: 30 s).

• PvP rewards increased

All PvP events now grant roughly 3× more medalions, and the cap limits have been raised accordingly.

 
Gameplay Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/22db47e819ad509613624d64ffc0956938fbcb24.jpg"]

 

• Re-balanced energy consumption

Electricity can no longer power everything at once; you must now allocate it wisely between firepower, speed, and survivability. All weapons and equipment draw significantly more energy. The longer a weapon’s range, the higher its energy cost.

 

• Removed the deck-pump limit

Survivability now depends on how much energy and deck space you’re willing to invest in pumps.

 

• Added wind turbines

Wind turbines can be crafted at your base. This is a fast and efficient way to achieve a small but comfortable energy level.

 

• Changed cargo loss mechanics after defeat

When your ship sinks, the contents of your hold no longer drop as a crate into the sea, so you won’t have to return for lost cargo after respawning. Any active insurances are automatically converted into medalions.

 

• New respawn location after sinking

By default, you now respawn at Three Whales after your ship sinks (with exceptions for certain quests and PvP events). The Translocator still allows teleportation to any previously visited location.

 

• Adjusted weapon parameters

Shotguns, grenade launchers, and machine guns have been substantially buffed to keep pace with cannons and rockets. All high-level weapons now boast increased durability. As before, longer-range weapons consume more energy and now also aim more slowly. Grenade launcher projectiles detonate on contact with water.

 

Note: Only the base stats of all weapons have been changed; unique multipliers remain intact. For example, if your Cannon III PP 60 mm had a displayed damage of 1 200 before the update (with a base of 1 000), and the base damage is now raised to 2 000, the cannon’s damage stat will update to 2 400 (preserving its +20% multiplier).

To reduce changelog note length, only the changes for Level VI weapons are listed below:

 
Cannon VI PP 100 mm
• Durability: 3 000 → 15 000 (×5)

• Damage: 3 375 → 6 750 (×2)

• Splash damage: 60 → 300 (×5)

• Reload speed: 2.08 s → 4.16 s (×2)

• Rotation speed: 78 → 26 (×0.33)

• Energy per shot: 80 → 160 (×2)

• Energy consumption: –11 → –72

The longer reload is offset by higher damage; misses are now costlier. Rotation speed was reduced to curb ranged weapons’ dominance at close quarters. Energy draw was increased in line with the “longer range = more energy” concept.

 
Rocket Launcher VI Baal
• Durability: 3 750 → 18 750 (×5)

• Energy per shot: 120 → 480 (×4)

• Energy consumption: –11 → –84
 Grenade Launcher VI M66
• Durability: 1 500 → 10 500 (×7)

• Damage: 135 → 810 (×6)

• Splash damage: 220 → 1 320 (×6)

• Rate of fire: 6 shots/s → 2 shots/s (×0.33)

• Projectile speed: 104 → 208 (×2)

• Projectile range: 350 → 525 (×1.5)

• Max dispersion: 10° → 5°

• Reload speed: 3.85 s → 15.4 s (×4)

• Ammo capacity: 48 → 16

• Energy per shot: 1 → 25 (×25)

• Energy consumption: –7 → –52 (×7.43)

 
Machine Gun VI VT-62
• Durability: 2 000 → 32 000 (×16)

• Damage: 165 → 495 (×3)

• Rotation speed: 130 → 87 (×0.67)

• Energy per shot: 12.8 → 10 (×0.78)

• Energy consumption: –7 → –50 (×7.1)

 
Flak Cannon VI Cree
• Durability: 1 500 → 10 500 (×7)

• Damage: 153 → 306 (×2)

• Ammo capacity: 26 → 16 (×0.62)

• Rotation speed: 390 → 210 (×0.54)

• Reload speed: 4.23 s → 9.3 s (×2.2)

• Energy consumption: –6 → –30 (×5)

 
Skills
 

• Reduced effectiveness of the Alter Ego skill “Drill”:

– Level 1: 15% → 5%

– Level 2: 30% → 10%

In combination with crew members who speed up reloads, this skill was giving an excessive boost to weapons with small magazines (especially cannons).

 

• Increased effectiveness of the Alter Ego perk “Metal Hull Specialist”:

– Per skill level: 5% → 20%

– Total at 3 levels: 15% → 60%

 
Ship Stat Changes
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/927bc31c6505d0c3283906d3042c45672e9f1d0d.jpg"]

• Re-balanced stats for all Rank III, IV, and V ships.

Now there is no universally “best” vessel at each tier—you must choose between speed, hull strength, displacement, deck size, etc.

 

• Overhauled hull-material balance.

The speed modifier of the hull material now applies not only to the ship’s built-in engine but to all installed motors.

Metal hulls have become tougher overall.

 

• Reduced reverse-thrust power:

– All Rank V ships: 10 times

– All Rank IV ships: 5 times

 

• Grasp Tugboat (Rank V)

– Base speed: 40 → 25

– Displacement: 900 000 → 800 000

– Hull mass: 300 000 → 375 000

– Hull strength: 2 500 → 5 000

 

• Torpedo Boat Midori (Rank V)

– Base speed: 50 → 35

– Displacement: 900 000 → 850 000

– Hull strength: 2 400 → 3 600

– Fixed built-in engine power: 1 800 000 → 750 000

 

• Burdock Gunboat (Rank V)

– Base speed: 50 → 45

– Hull mass: 140 000 → 220 000

– Displacement: 400 000 → 600 000

– Hull strength: 2 273 → 3 300

 

• Glare Rocket Boat (Rank V)

– Base speed: 45 → 55

– Hull strength: 2 350 → 2 500

 

• Brawler Torpedo Boat (Rank IV)

– Base speed: 45 → 57

– Hull strength: 2 350 → 2 500

– Displacement: 200 000 → 280 000

– Hull strength: 1 200 → 1 000

 

• Bastion Boat (Rank IV):

– Hull strength 1 000 → 1 100

 

• Anchovy Trawler (Rank IV):

– Hull strength 1 126 → 2 200

– Displacement 470 000 → 500 000

 

• BK Muraena Patrol Boat (Rank IV):

– Hull strength 1 120 → 2 900

– Displacement 290 000 → 350 000

 

• Vigilant Patrol Boat (Rank III):

– Base speed 60 → 55

 

• Limousine (Rank III):

– Hull strength 550 → 350;

– Self-powered energy output 38 → 128

 

• Shamrock Trawler (Rank III):

– Hull strength 583 → 650;

– Displacement 240 000 → 280 000

 

• Walrus Tugboat (Rank III):

– Hull strength 600 → 1 200

 

• Horizon Boat (Rank III):

– Hull strength 620 → 800

– Displacement 500 000 → 650 000

 
Hull Material Changes
 

• Removed an unintended dependency of flooded hold volume on hull material. All materials are now equal in that respect.

• The hull material speed modifier now affects every engine—not just the built-in one.

 

• Plastic Sheathing:

– Speed bonus: 15% → 20%

– Mass reduction bonus: –25% → –30%

 

• Metal Sheathing:

– Mass penalty: +25% → +15%

– Speed penalty: –15% → –25%

 
Changes to Generators, Batteries, and Structural Modules
 

• Rebalanced output bonuses of structural modules that affect generator energy production. Higher tier modules now grant a larger energy-per-deck-space bonus. The rare Three-Story Cabin has been updated to fit the new balance.

• Adjusted durability and mass for almost all modules to improve strength-to-weight ratios. Tier IV and V wheelhouses gained additional attachment points.

• You may now install only one wheelhouse per ship. Tier IV and V wheelhouses received internal attachment points and significantly boosted bonuses.

• Reduced battery capacities for Tiers II–IV:

– Battery: 450 → 150

– Medium Battery: 975 → 250

– High-Capacity Battery: 3 150 → 750

– Powerful Battery: 6 750 → 2 000

• The capacity bonus from structural modules now applies to all batteries on deck, not only those installed inside structures.

• The following modules can now be rotated: Halibut Conning Tower, Spain Trawler Cabin Hold, Oil Cistern Body, Oil Cistern Tail, Surveyor Cabin, Looter Drone.

 
Changes to Pumps and Engines
 

To reduce changelog note length, only the changes for Level IV and VI equipment are listed below.

 

With the removal of the pump count limit, pump energy consumption has been increased:

• Electric Pump: –15 → –150

• Fire-Fighting Motor Pump: –7 → –75

• Mid-Class Pump: –5 → –35

• Gasoline Motor Pump: –2 → –5

High speed propulsion now costs much more energy.

 
Gigantic Engine
• Durability: 5 000 → 15 000 (×3)

• Energy consumption: –30 → –360

• Max Speed: 25 → 45 (×1.8)

• Power output: 8 000 → 240 000

• Energy consumption during boost: 125 units/s → 480 units/s

 
Very Large Outboard Engine
• Durability: 3 000 → 9 000 (×3)

• Energy consumption: –20 → –180

• Max Speed: 20 → 30 (×1.5)

• Power output: 4 000 → 120 000

• Energy consumption during boost: 100 units/s → 360 units/s

 
Vayu Fan Motor
• Max Speed: 25 → 15

• Power output: 8 000 → 90 000

• Energy consumption: –30 → –180

• Energy consumption during boost: 125 units/s → 150 units/s

 
Moryana Fan Motor
• Max Speed: 20 → 10

• Power output: 4 000 → 50 000

• Energy consumption: –20 → –120

• Energy consumption during boost: 100 units/s → 120 units/s

 
Changes to Funnels and Air Intakes
 

• Gigantic Funnel

– Reduced module height (no longer obstructs view)

– Durability: 18 800 → 42 000

– Power output: 200 000 → 300 000

 

• Medium Funnel

– Visual tweak: reduced height

– Durability: 4 700 → 12 800

– Power output: 48 000 → 120 000

– Energy consumption: –24 → –36

 

• Steam Engine Air Intake

– Attachment points: 9 → 4 (power per point increased accordingly)

– Power output: 36 000 → 26 000

– Rotation disabled in build mode

 
Other Changes and Improvements
 

• Camera shake on incoming splash damage has been toned down.

• Captain level now displays next to player nickname.

• In hull sheathing mode, you can now cover the entire deck or all segments at once by holding Ctrl (PC), □ (PS5), or X (Xbox).

• In paint mode, those same keys let you repaint all identical items at once (e.g., all hull plates or all Tier V machine guns).

• Added new on-foot areas.

• You can now form a group without friending first—invite via search or the “Nearby Players” tab in the Friends menu.

• On-foot mode is now available in all main locations; the option to disable it was removed for performance reasons.

• Base entry now happens through a dialogue with Vix at the Three Whales dock.

• You can open inventory, map, etc., while on foot (excluding combat).

• Many quest objectives were fixed to ensure proper group completion credit.

• Quest markers now appear in swim mode to show docking points with quest dialogue.

• Item gain/spend pop-ups now display during dialogues.

• Balance and difficulty for battles in the exploration quests for base tech upgrades have been improved.

• Medallion rewards for sinking Jared’s enhanced ships beyond the teleports have been increased.

• Changed Mechanism Parts recipe:

– Was: Scrap Iron × 18, Reagents × 1

– Now: Scrap Iron × 4, Scrap Copper × 4, Chemical Waste × 3

• Progression blockers in quests for players who switch factions have been fixed.

• Various quest bugs, missing markers, and inaccuracies have been fixed.

 
Increased Rewards in PvP Missions
 
“Attack on Caravan”
• Escort time reward for defenders: 5 → 50 medallions per second

• Reward for sinking another player: 500 → 1 000 medallions

• Reward for sinking the flagship: 1 800 → 25 000 medallions

• Assist reward on flagship sinking: 900 → 5 000 medallions

• Per player reward cap: 50 000 → 150 000 medallions

 
“Mangrove Pearl”
• Take out reward: 6 000 → 25 000 medallions

• All secondary action medallion rewards roughly ×3

 
“Treasure Rush”
• Capture time reward: 80 → 1 000 medallions per second

• Reward for sinking another player: 500 → 1 000 medallions

• Per player reward cap: 50 000 → 150 000 medallions

notes.title: The release of Age of Water and a 50% discount on all editions
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=q78rT6VJGrE;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re happy to announce that with the Beyond the Waves update, we officially conclude the Early Access phase of Age of Water. Thanks to the numerous players who actively participated in Early Access, we’ve released 32 updates where we introduced many improvements and fixed bugs to make the game even better and more fun to play.

To commemorate the release of Age of Water, we’re offering a 50% discount on all editions of the game until January 30th (16:00 GMT). Invite your friends and set sail for exciting adventures in Age of Water!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695490/Age_of_Water/

Pioneer’s Cap as a gift!
Great news for Steam Early Access participants, as well for PlayStation and Xbox players! Everyone who purchased Age of Water up until and including January 15th, 2025, will get the Pioneer’s Cap as a gift. Don’t forget to enter the game and find it among your personal belongings in the hold of your ship.
Players who bought the game after January 15th, but played the Age of Water: The First Voyage prologue or tried the game during the free weekend, will also get this cap.

notes.title: Meet the Beyond the Waves update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/970f9211edaf1dfa07b3c6f0d76d7778e2d3cce4.jpg
We’re proud to present the Beyond the Waves update featuring captivating storylines, powerful weapons and new challenges that are sure to please even the most seasoned captains.
The update introduces an entirely new team-based PvP mode, Control Points, where players must work together to capture and defend strategically important locations scattered across the waters. For those seeking even greater challenges, the game now features five dangerous zones, each guarded by formidable bosses of varying difficulty levels. Additionally, exciting stories await you in a new quest line. Your team will also gain a new crew member.

In this episode, we invite you to face off against a world boss lurking beyond the sector's edge. This unique new enemy will test your combat skills and strategies, delivering an epic battle unlike anything you've seen before in Age of Water.
To help you deal with the enemies more effectively, you can unlock a sixth tier of weapons with devastating firepower, including rocket launchers!

The world of Age of Water has become even more diverse with the addition of ten new land-based combat areas. Your crew will engage in intense close-quarters combat, while you'll need to adapt to new conditions and employ previously unseen tactics.

Full list of changes:

 Added a new group PvP mode "Treasure Rush".
 Added five new boss locations with increasing difficulty.
 Added a unique world super boss outside the sector.
 Added 10 locations for a new type of missions — ground combat.
 Added the ability to obtain 6th rank weapons.
 Added a new type of weapon — rocket launcher.
 Added a new quest line that will unlock upon completing all base quests, The Battle for Three Whales, as well as the Tirpitz and Aircraft Carrier quest chains.
 Added a new crew member.
 Added Chinese and Russian voiceovers.
 Added new paints that can be earned as rewards for completing ground combat zones.
 Added support for Steam Game Recording feature.
 Added highlighting for chat messages.
 Improved the effect of ship disappearance at range.
 Improved AI behavior.
 Improved buoy and docked player boat behavior.
 The map always opens centered, even if many areas outside the sector are open.
 Changed the balance of hull armor.
 Changed the balance of fiber acquisition.
 Reduced excessive drop of small bait, adjusted fishing reward balance.
 Fixed a bug where loot from large fish could be missing.
 Modules in the preview are no longer painted.
 Fixed a bug causing prolonged freezes on PlayStation 5.
 Fixed bugs in displaying the player blacklist on Xbox.
 Fixed bugs that caused voice chat to disconnect.
 Fixed logical errors that led to progress blockage in quests "Recruitment", "A Geographical Hypothesis" and "Murderous Balloon".
 Fixed a bug where a quest object could appear inside the "Three Whales" location.
 Fixed a bug where no corks were awarded in the quest "Under Pressure".
 Fixed a bug where opponents without segments and large modules received too little damage from explosions.
 Fixed an issue with the disappearance of some modules installed on the "Merchant" cabin.
 Fixed a bug where a building could be available for construction at the base only after some time.
 Fixed a bug where the scanner might not react to mining zones.

Soon after the Beyond the Waves launches, we will conclude the Early Access phase and officially release the final version of Age of Water.

notes.title: Update “Against the Tide”
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ba3xXx7klYI;full][/previewyoutube]

The major update will bring numerous improvements, including: a new quest line and ships, instant building construction, enhanced weapons, a drone for automatic loot collection, improved speed balance, and much more. 

The full list of changes

 Continuation of the Silver Fleet questline, concluding the main story of the current game season.
 Antagonist questline featuring battles against four new bosses.
 Quests to recruit two new crew members.
 The shipwright now has three new unique ships. They can be obtained by completing his quests.
 Crafting items and building structures no longer require time. Ship module and weapon repair time has been significantly reduced. Dismantling buildings at the base returns 90% of the resources.
 New enhanced weapons: "reinforced" for ranks 2 and 3 and "shark" for ranks 4 and 5. Enhanced weapons require fragments, which are obtained through fishing, treasure hunting, shark hunting, among shipwrecks of Armadas and some other ships. Crafted at the base.
 New Armadas for playing at maximum difficulty. Lots of experience, medallions, and resources for crafting enhanced weapons. Also, new ships of ranks 3, 4, and 5 for boarding.
 Increased experience gained when sinking large ships. Added cork drops.
 Repeatable PVP/PVE quests for late game stages.
 Drone for automatic loot collection. Built at the base.
 New modules, including rare and themed ones. Obtained from enemies.
 New paints available in the base store.
 Improved balance of the power supply system. Changed parameters of batteries, generators, boost, and some skills.
 Improved speed balance. Changed parameters of some engines and hulls. Returned capacities, energy consumption during boost, etc. Improved stability during turns.
 Increased efficiency of high-rank pumps.
 Many deck superstructures now have modifiers for the equipment installed onto them. 
 The Armada spawn points and fishing locations are now shown on the map. 
 Now when crafting items and resources at your base, you can choose the quantity beforehand.
 Armor modules now cover the hull better.
 Sailor Lin will be able to wear a wig.
 Fishing rods now have different ranks and are available for crafting at the base.
 The ship’s rank is now visible in the Ship Menu.
 Fixed various map, inventory and item display bugs.
 Improved stability of engine sounds.
 Fixed problems with calculating some achievements.
 Fixed the battering ram damage. 
 Fixed problems with the battle at Camel Rock.
 Time for changing the flag for PvP has been reduced to 15 minutes.
 Time for boarding a defeated ship has been increased to 20 minutes. The hold of your previous ship now becomes a player’s "Lost Cargo" chest and won’t be lost. 
 Minefields with a lot of explosives now appear more frequently. Increased the number of resources acquired from broken and deactivated mines.
 Improved anchored ship stability.
 Added an arrow showing the exact direction of the whirlpool teleport. 
 Many corrections in the models of characters, interiors, islands, etc.
 Fixed bugs in various quests.
 Fixed the "shaking" of NPC in dialogues.
 Added voicelines for some dialogues.
 Refined some texts and descriptions.
 Some UI improvements for game controllers.

The episode "Against the Tide" concludes the storyline that began with the release of the base game in the spring of this year.

notes.title: FAQ. Part 1: more about the game release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/dcc12fbf4074ea42a738c98f43bdf51b81bbfd9f.jpg

Last week we announced to you, the estimated dates when Age of Water will be available for purchase on Steam. This wonderful news raised several related questions, which we plan to regularly collect on the game's official platforms and prepare answers for you.

Today we will answer the main questions about PVP, game localization and the fate of CBT buyers.

Q. Will you send an activation code to those who purchased the CBT?
If you purchased one of the Early Access packs back in the summer, you will get a copy of the game once it's launched on Steam.

Q. How much will the game cost and what languages will be featured in the game?
The release version will feature all the languages that are listed on the game's Steam page (Russian, English, German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese). We will tell you about the prices later, stay tuned.

Q. Are there any projects to translate the game into other languages?
The game is localized into a number of languages at release time. We will see later if it will need any additional language.

Q. Is the game all about PVP?
PvP in the game is optional, mostly you do fight AI enemies etc. in the open world. 

Q. When you say PvP is optional do you mean I can play the game with PvP disabled between players but players are still present or is it more like a private instance where other players (aside from friends I invite) can't join at all?
As of now you will always witness other players in the game, and they can see you. You won't be able to attack each other unless you deliberately go to a special area. So if you'd like to play the game without ever engaging in PvP activities, you can totally do it.

Q. Will it have a true open world, accessible for all players on the server, or separate maps with a certain player limit?
It is a "layered" scheme. As in, all the players are on a single server, but they are distributed between different instances. So if you want to play with your friends, you have to make sure you're in the same one

Q. Is this game only an MMO or can we play solo, like making quests to the main lore, etc?
The game has a PvE story-based campaign.

Q. So this game is an MMO. Does it mean that it will be f2p, as most MMO's are?
Age of Water will be a paid title, you purchase it once and there will be no subscription.

We’ll collect your questions in the future and definitely prepare part two. So, don’t be shy and write to us on all our official pages: Facebook,  X, Instagram, Discord or Steam.
